turns.replyTail:
AI says:
I’m sorry for the delay. Please check whether your order has been dispatched. You’ll receive a dispatch email with tracking details once shipped. Orders dispatch Monday–Friday; weekend orders are packed the following Monday for afternoon dispatch. Delays may result from split shipments, remote locations, weather, courier disruptions, or delivery attempts. If there’s still no update or delivery card, please contact customer support.

rvice · AI
